 Search Home New Top Charts Sign In October 24 Bass creates crisis call center, ICE documentation, Pershing Square station renamed — Evening Edition The LA Report 5m L.A Mayor Karen Bass signed an executive directive today to create the city's first ever unified call center for crisis response. Raid response network SELA releases their numbers on ICE documentation. The Metro board voted to rename the Pershing Square Metro station after Bridget “Biddy” Mason, a woman who went from enslavement to owning much of what’s now downtown Los Angeles. Plus, more on Evening Edition.
